description: This file defines the NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler class, which implements the IStreamFailureHandler interface. The class provides a no-operation implementation for handling stream delivery and subscription failures within the Orleans streaming framework.

classes.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
classes.description: A failure handler that does nothing upon stream failure events.

methods.name: NoOpStreamDeliveryFailureHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the failure handler, optionally set to fault on error.

methods.name: OnDeliveryFailure
methods.description: Method invoked on delivery failure; implemented as a no-op.

methods.name: OnSubscriptionFailure
methods.description: Method invoked on subscription failure; implemented as a no-op.
